name: codyte-spawn-optimized-agents
description: Universal Master Orchestrator for goal-driven agent swarms with mandatory cost optimization. Works for any project, but auto-detects Codyte context (c:\Server_Dev) and activates mandatory multi-tenant enforcement: tenant isolation, multi-unit entitlement, Memory V3, n8n integration, audit trails, CLAUDE.md compliance. Sub-agents: planner, security, coder, reviewer, monitor. Real-time cost tracking, context reuse (150x-12.5kx speedup), 60-85% token savings.
author: Carlos Ortiz

cost_optimization.description: Real-time token accounting, budget enforcement, cost delta reporting

goal_decomposition.description: Strategic intent → sub-goals, dependency analysis, critical path

context_reuse.description: Vector DB injection (HNSW), 150x-12.5kx speedup, 60-85% token savings

observability.description: Real-time metrics, cost alerts, live progress tracking

tenant_isolation.description: Enforces WHERE tenant_id = ? at SQL, application, and Memory V3 layers. Cross-tenant tests required.

multi_unit_entitlement.description: Validates automation_enabled + billing_status before Decision/Commitment webhooks. Logs fallback_reason to audit trail.

memory_v3_per_tenant.description: Per-tenant SQLite + HNSW indexing. Factory pattern: get_memory_service(tenant_id). 150x-12.5kx search speedup.

n8n_webhook_orchestration.description: Decision + Commitment webhooks. No direct n8n calls from channels; all via backend.

audit_trail.description: metadata_json persistence: dispatcher_execution_id, tenant_id, conversation_id, route_final, commitment_status, fallback_reason.

security_review.description: Input validation, XSS/CSRF protection, tenant isolation, rate limiting, no secrets in response

planner.codyte_focus: Database migration order, backward compatibility, n8n webhook sequencing

security.codyte_focus: Input validation, tenant isolation audit, rate limiting, compliance (PCI DSS if payments)

coder.codyte_focus: Routes (FastAPI), schemas (Pydantic), database CRUD, Memory V3 factory, test coverage

reviewer.codyte_focus: Tenant isolation verification, no credential leaks, tests passing, CLAUDE.md compliance

monitor.codyte_focus: Test results, contract validation, smoke script status, tenant filter enforcement

project_context_detection.codyte_mode_activated_when: Current working directory is c:\Server_Dev OR project root detected as Codyte
project_context_detection.detection_method: Auto-scan for CLAUDE.md + backend/app.py + PostgreSQL schema

universal.cost_optimization: Real-time tracking via cost-optimize; no hidden costs
universal.context_reuse: v3-memory-unification for semantic search; 60-85% token savings target
universal.quality_gates: Reviewer gate before completion; assertions verified

codyte_mode.tenant_isolation: WHERE tenant_id = ? in all queries; Memory V3 factory enforcement; cross-tenant tests
codyte_mode.multi_unit_entitlement: Check automation_enabled + billing_status before Decision/Commitment; log fallback_reason
codyte_mode.n8n_contracts: Decision + Commitment webhook validation; no direct calls from channels; all via /webhook-* endpoints
codyte_mode.audit_trail: metadata_json fully populated: dispatcher_execution_id, tenant_id, route_final, commitment_status, fallback_reason
codyte_mode.testing: All tests passing; contract validation; smoke scripts green; cross-tenant isolation verified
codyte_mode.claude_md_compliance: CLAUDE.md mandatory practices enforced via agent checklist

tenant_isolation.requirement: Every query filters by tenant_id; cross-tenant tests pass
